prompt:
High-fidelity desktop app UI mockup, macOS style window, WeChat-desktop-inspired light theme, Chinese UI, flat minimal design, no gradients, exact text rendering.

SHELL: top 28px window title bar in near-white #fafafa with a thin bottom border and macOS traffic lights at top-left. Below it a slim left icon rail (same #fafafa background, thin right border) with 7 rounded square icons stacked vertically: chat bubble, users (contacts), globe (network), bell (ACTIVE - icon in WeChat green #07c160 with a small red #fa5151 rounded pill badge showing "3" at its top-right corner), open book, share nodes; settings gear pinned at the bottom of the rail. All other rail icons neutral gray. Thin status bar strip at the very bottom with tiny gray text "节点在线 · 直连 4 / 中继 1".

CONTENT AREA (white background, 24px padding): this is a message center PAGE titled "消息中心" with subtitle "入群邀请与好友邀请统一处理" in gray. Top-right of the header: a macOS style segmented control with gray track and two segments: "待处理 3" (selected, white pill, subtle shadow) and "历史消息" (unselected, gray text).

Two stacked sections. Each section header: a small rounded-square colored icon chip + section title + a small red #fa5151 count pill.

SECTION 1 header: green #07c160 rounded-square chip with white group-of-users glyph, title "入群邀请", red count pill "1".
  Card 1 (white card, 10px rounded corners, 1px light gray ring, 12px padding):
  - first line: small gray pill "收到的", group name "研发协作群" in medium weight, then right-aligned: solid green #07c160 small button "同意", light gray outline small button "拒绝", gray pill "待处理", gray 12px time "10:24".
  - second line: small monospace gray peer id "12D3KooW…8f2a" with a tiny copy icon.
  - third line: 12px note text "备注：想加入内核开发讨论".

SECTION 2 header: soft blue rounded-square chip with white person-plus glyph, title "好友邀请", red count pill "2".
  Card 2 (same card style):
  - first line: gray pill "收到的", name "李四" medium, right-aligned: small text input box with placeholder "备注昵称", solid green button "同意", outline button "拒绝", gray pill "待处理", gray time "14:05".
  - second line: monospace peer id "12D3KooW…c41d" with tiny copy icon.
  - third line: note "备注：你好，我是会议上认识的阿强".
  Card 3 (same card style):
  - first line: gray pill "发出的", name "王五", right-aligned: outline button "撤回", gray pill "待处理", gray time "周三 09:12".
  - second line: monospace peer id "12D3KooW…9b07" with tiny copy icon.

Overall: system sans-serif Chinese typography, muted grays, generous whitespace, crisp 1px borders, WeChat desktop aesthetic, light theme only.
